body.statement: Dwivedi et al.'s published Assumptions 6--7 permit bounded coordinatewise Lipschitz nonlinear functions of exogenous unit and time factors supported on a compact cube with lower-bounded time-factor density, and their Theorem 4.1 gives the corresponding unit-by-time nearest-neighbor error bound under Assumptions 1, 2, 4, 6, and 7.

attestation.note: Checked against Assumptions 6--7 and Theorem 4.1 in the accepted-version PDF.
